$comment: Performance preset for a machine with BOTH an OpenAI subscription and OpenCode Go, refreshed 2026-11-16. OpenAI drives the synthesis/decision/implementation lanes with GPT-6.1 Sol; GPT-6.1 Terra takes design and vision (better writing/visual reasoning than Luna, much faster than Sol, $1/$5); OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4.1-Flash handles recon/docs and supplies the council's DeepSeek base advisor. Model families are restricted to GPT, DeepSeek, and GLM-5.3-Flash (GLM not required); Sol runs only at medium/high/xhigh and DeepSeek only at high/max. Requires ChatGPT/Codex OAuth (OpenAI Business/Enterprise workplace entitlement) for the openai provider; Go is quota-limited per model (no automatic fallback). Covers all eight standalone agents (observer ships disabled). Apply with: ./setup.sh --preset openai-go-performance. Agents not listed follow the global model.
